properties.title: 432 Park Avenue completed in Midtown
properties.short_description: SLCE Architects records 432 Park Avenue in New York with status completed in 2015.
properties.explanation: A 96-storey residential tower and associated retail, office, and public-plaza components were completed near Park Avenue and 57th Street.

properties.title: Asser Levy Playground expansion opened
properties.short_description: NYC Parks recorded a January 30, 2015 ribbon cutting for the enhanced and enlarged Asser Levy Playground beside Asser Levy Recreation Center and Pool.
properties.explanation: A former underused roadbed entered documented public park use with recreation amenities including turf field, exercise track, adult fitness equipment, seating, lighting, and trees.

properties.title: Barrier Free Living Residences development opened in Mott Haven
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on September 24, 2015 the grand opening of the Barrier Free Living Residences in Mott Haven.
properties.explanation: A documented housing-finance release recorded opening of a two-building supportive housing development.

properties.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden opened its new Discovery Garden
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Botanic Garden recorded that the new Discovery Garden opened on the Saturday after its June 5, 2015 preview story.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Bedford Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission designation report records the Bedford Historic District designation in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, on December 8, 2015.
properties.explanation: A documented heritage-designation status change was recorded for the named site.

properties.title: Belle Harbor Sandy rehabilitation groundbreaking was recorded
properties.short_description: NYC DDC's news archive records an August 17, 2015 groundbreaking for a FEMA-funded Belle Harbor rehabilitation project covering roadways, sidewalks, sewers, and water mains.
properties.explanation: A documented city design-and-construction news record marked construction start for coastal-neighborhood public-realm and infrastructure rehabilitation.

properties.title: Bronx Zoo Children's Zoo reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: The Wildlife Conservation Society recorded the official reopening of the Bronx Zoo Children's Zoo on May 30, 2015 after renovation work.
properties.explanation: A documented reopening milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Brookfield Place retail opened in Lower Manhattan
properties.short_description: amNewYork reported Brookfield Place officially opening its new retail collection on 26 March 2015 at 200 Vesey Street.
properties.explanation: A renovated World Financial Center retail and dining complex entered public use as Brookfield Place.

properties.title: Cary Leeds Center for Tennis and Learning opened in Crotona Park
properties.short_description: New York Junior Tennis and Learning records that the Cary Leeds Center for Tennis and Learning launched its flagship facility in Crotona Park with a ribbon-cutting on June 15, 2015.

properties.title: Crown Heights North III Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission map materials record the Crown Heights North III Historic District, LP-2489, as designated on March 24, 2015 in Brooklyn.
